component.name: r2modman
component.summary: A simple and easy to use mod manager for many games using Thunderstore

description.p: The official Flathub release of r2modman, a simple and easy to use mod manager for many games using Thunderstore.

ul.li: You must ensure that the r2modman Flatpak has permissions to access the directory containing the game files for the game you want to mod. The only default supported locations are ~/.local/share/Steam and ~/.var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam
When using a Flatpak game launcher, like Flatpak Steam, you must ensure that it has access to your r2modman data directory. The default location is in ~/.var/app/io.github.ebkr.r2modman.
